title: [29.x]-"The record in table Reminder Line already exists." error appears if you Create Reminders for a Customer with all the Open Entries On Hold and no Reminder Free applied on the Reminder Terms used.
summary: Fixed an error that occurred when creating reminders for customers with all open entries on hold and no reminder free applied on the reminder terms.
key_points: Resolves duplicate record error in Reminder Line table
Affects reminder creation process for customers with on-hold entries
Requires no reminder free amount in reminder terms configuration
Changes made to Reminder Communication codeunit
